 Cloud Engineer (GCP, Terraform) at BairesDev
 In this role, you'll build and run cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud as part of a collaborative team. You'll automate environments and help keep platforms reliable and easy to deploy to.
 What You'll Do:
 - Build and manage infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform.
 - Automate environments with Terraform.
 - Run Kubernetes workloads on GKE.
 - Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines.
 - Write scripts to automate operational tasks.
 What we are looking for:
 - Hands-on work with Google Cloud Platform.
 - Proficiency in Terraform and infrastructure as code.
 - Familiarity with Kubernetes, ideally GKE.
 - Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines.
 - Skill scripting in Bash or Python.
 - Advanced level of English.
 How we do make your work (and your life) easier:
 - 100% remote work (from anywhere).

 - Flexible hours: create your own schedule.

 Apply now and become part of a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive!
